**Finding: missing (medium severity) — validated redline submitted.**

What I found:
- The Agreement has a single termination-effects provision, section 4(c) (p0019–p0022): Kubient ceases the Services, the section 3 licence is revoked, Customer stops using the platform, and each Party "return[s] or destroy[s] any of the other Party's Confidential Information."
- Targeted searches for transition / wind-down / export / migration / assistance returned zero hits; no other clause addresses data return. There is no defined "Customer Data" term, so the redline uses the document's own defined terms ("Content", "Requests").

Why it fails the fallback:
- No transition assistance at all (fallback requires 90 days), and no data export obligation in a usable format. The "return **or destroy**" option lets Kubient destroy our material on termination, which is squarely the walk-away outcome for a hosted auction-platform service.

Redline (ok:true): new sub-clauses (v)–(vii) inserted after p0022 giving up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter — the preferred position, with the 90-day fallback offered in the comment.
